baseline: Fresh F1 per trial; compare original NA/NOTE hash; intentional imported-PDF deletion excluded from unintended-loss count

faults.name: Runtime refused
faults.injection: Inject connection-refused transport for fixed http://127.0.0.1:11434 in the isolated QA adapter; do not change allowed host/port or stop a real user runtime.

faults.name: Runtime timeout
faults.injection: Pause response and advance fake clock to deadline.

faults.name: Stale evidence
faults.injection: Increment course library revision before final publication.

faults.name: Queued cancellation
faults.injection: Cancel saved queued job before claim.

faults.name: Restart interruption
faults.injection: Terminate isolated app before job publication, then restart.

faults.name: Locked write
faults.injection: Hold exclusive SQLite writer lock longer than 2 seconds.
faults.expected: STORAGE_BUSY or specified storage failure; no partial write or note loss.

faults.name: Failed migration
faults.injection: Create backup, then inject migration exception.
faults.expected: Old data retained; recovery explanation; no silent empty DB.

faults.name: Locked managed-file cleanup
faults.injection: Lock separate managed PDF copy during confirmed deletion, then unlock/restart.
faults.expected: Source immediately unusable; cleanup pending until recovery; NOTE retained.
